name: references
description: Cross-file usages of a symbol, incl. usage counts. Use full member path (obj.method). Prefer over grep. AUTO-FRESH: files modified after last index are re-indexed automatically on read — explicit reindex only needed for brand-new workspaces/files.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

symbol.description: Symbol name / call target to find references for

file.description: Restrict to file rel to root; not a dir; omit = project-wide

kind.description: Y002-S4 kind filter: comma-separated call/import/use/assign/extends/implements. Invalid kinds ignored with kind_filter_note.
